authentication: Verified owner Authorization Bearer required on every operation; state and leave additionally require X-Cosmos-Surface-Token

connection.token: 64 lowercase hex characters; returned only here

POST /.semantics: Explicit approval or reapproval atomically rotates connection and records approval; initial visible=false, sequence=0

DELETE /:surfaceId.semantics: Owner revokes approval and invalidates connection

POST /:surfaceId/state.semantics: Strictly increasing sequence; exact duplicate is idempotent without renewing lease; different payload at same sequence or stale sequence is conflict

POST /:surfaceId/leave.semantics: Invalidates connection, not approval; rejoin requires explicit approval

Surface.name: Browser display
Surface.connected: boolean; server-derived from credential expiry, lease and leave/revoke
Surface.available: boolean; connected && visible; does not assert render verification or lead eligibility

limitations: Enrollment and metadata only, no assistant dispatch or rendered-action acknowledgment
Visibility never asserts occupancy, privacy or earned trust
Hash chaining has no external checkpoint or device countersignature yet
